caption: Ribe Cathedral, Ribe
composition: Single square Romanesque tower from the cathedral square · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the cathedral square, Ribe Cathedral is dominated by one massive square tower, the Commoner's Tower, in red brick with light stone corner quoins and a flat balustraded crown. It does not have Roskilde's twin spires. Half-timbered eaves sit at the edge of the square. The night is overcast, about 12.2°C, and the tower is lit by street lamps. The square is empty. Ribe remains the town name; the municipality since 2007 is Esbjerg.
